bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tumblrkit.telegram_bridge_client import LocalTelegramOwner
q="""SELECT d.posting_topic_id::text||','||d.telegram_message_id::text||','||
 CASE WHEN d.owner_user_id=g.owner_user_id THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
 FROM posting_deliveries d
 JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id
 JOIN targets g ON g.chat_id=t.chat_id AND g.target_type='entry_group'
 WHERE d.status='sent' AND d.source_type='announcement'
 AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL
 AND t.purpose='announcement' AND t.enabled=TRUE AND t.verified_at IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY d.delivery_id DESC LIMIT 6"""
rows=subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",q],text=True,timeout=12).strip().splitlines()
assert rows, "NO_EXISTING_RECEIPTS"
owner=LocalTelegramOwner(Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token")
for row in rows:
 topic,message,own=row.split(",")
 assert topic.isdecimal() and message.isdecimal() and own in ("0","1")
 result=owner.transport({"action":"readback","destination":topic,"message_id":message})
 assert result.get("verified") is (own=="1"),"RECEIPT_OWNER_BOUNDARY_BROKEN"
print("REAL_OWNER_BOUND_MPB_RECEIPTS=PASS")
PY
